name: Configuration and hosting modernization blocker
description: Flags web.config or app.config-heavy applications, binding redirects, machine.config assumptions, ConfigurationManager, packages.config, non-SDK-style projects, IIS-only assumptions, registry configuration, hard-coded file paths, UNC paths, and environment-specific transforms.
impact: Configuration and hosting assumptions often define the practical order of migration because they control startup, deployment, and environment-specific behavior.
evidenceRequirements: Configuration, project, package, file-path, namespace, or symbol facts must be available from prior extraction slices.
recommendedActions: Separate runtime configuration, transform behavior, hosting assumptions, and project-system constraints before moving the application.
